title: Kochi Navy Half Marathon 2026: participant essentials
description: Key registration, kit and race-day details for the 2026 Kochi Navy Half Marathon.
intro: The seventh edition is scheduled for 13 December 2026. This list brings together practical details from the organizer’s page; race information can change, so confirm each point with the organizer before you travel or register.

entries.name: Choose a race category
entries.description: The organizer lists a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km timed run and a 5 km fun run. The timing chip and timed e-certificate are described for the 21.1 km and 10 km categories.

entries.name: Check age conditions
entries.description: The event lists a minimum age of 18 for the half marathon and 14 for the 10 km. For the 5 km, the page lists age 12 and above and adds that younger participants must be accompanied by a parent or guardian; confirm eligibility directly with the organizer.

entries.name: Compare the time limits
entries.description: The published cut-offs are 3 hours 30 minutes for the half marathon, 1 hour 30 minutes for the 10 km, and one hour for the 5 km. Check for updates if your participation depends on a particular cut-off.

entries.name: Watch for the bib expo announcement
entries.description: The organizer says the expo date and venue are yet to be announced. It asks participants to bring registration confirmation and government photo ID; a person collecting for someone else should carry the participant’s ID and an authorization note.
entries.details: Date and venue to be announced

entries.name: Allow for different start and finish points
entries.description: The stated start is at Grand Hyatt Convention Center and the finish is at Bolgatty Palace Ground. A detailed route map is to be released closer to race day, according to the organizer.

entries.name: Recheck the provisional schedule
entries.description: The published flag-off times are marked provisional: 4:30 a.m. for 21.1 km, 5:30 a.m. for 10 km, and 7:15 a.m. for 5 km. Do not treat these as final until the organizer confirms them.

entries.name: Register ahead of race day
entries.description: The event FAQ says there will be no spot registration on race day. Use the organizer’s registration link and check availability and current fees before making plans.
